📖 How to use

      
  1. Upload a "before" image and an "after" image.
  2. Or press "Use canvas placeholders" to demo without uploads.
  3. Drag the slider handle on the live demo.
  4. Click "Copy snippet" and paste the HTML, CSS and JS into your page.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Are my images uploaded anywhere?
Both images are read locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.
Is the slider responsive?
Yes — the generated snippet is self-contained with no dependencies and resizes with its container.
Is it accessible?
The slider uses a range input with keyboard support, so it is usable via keyboard and screen readers.
